details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept that beacons host metadata to a callback server at install time. It uses the sentinel version 99.0.1 on a scoped name and a postinstall hook ("node beacon.cjs") that sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with the header x-beacon-package. The JSON body contains only the package name, the machine hostname, the install path, the current working directory, the npm user-agent string and the protocol — no credentials, tokens, environment values or file contents are collected or transmitted. The package's index.js fires the same beacon when the module is required and exports a catch-all Proxy so that importing the name does not crash the build before the callback completes. The README describes the package as part of an authorized dependency-confusion test that reports only that it was installed.
